SL01.answer_text: Total primary sales value (sell-in to distributors) in Q1 FY27 (1 Apr – 30 Jun 2026) was ₹1,482,535,220.12, across 3,050 invoices.

SL03.question: What was the company-wide DSO on invoices raised in FY26 (April 2025 to March 2026)?
SL03.answer_text: The company-wide DSO on invoices raised in FY26 (April 2025 to March 2026) was 50 days.
sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT SUM(days_outstanding) / COUNT(*) AS dso FROM marts.fct_invoice_collections AS f JOIN marts.dim_date AS d ON d.date_day = f.invoice_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 2026) AS q LIMIT 500

input.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(days_outstanding) / SUM(qty) AS dso
FROM (
  SELECT
    f.days_outstanding,
    f.qty
  FROM marts.fct_invoice_collections f
  JOIN marts.dim_date d ON d.date_day = f.invoice_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 2026
) sub;
